"Accessibility Services are used solely for professional features. We do not collect, save, or share your data, and it is never sent over the network or to third parties."

"ClipZ's accessibility service grants you Pro features:
- A smart floating bubble with instant actions and full customization capability. - Secure and automatic saving of everything you copy, with flexible retention duration. - AI-powered tools for translation, correction, summarization, rephrasing, and content creation. - Quick access to all features from system buttons. - Instant sharing and direct text passing to other apps. - Advanced screen scanner to extract text, with scrolling support to extract full conversations or long texts.
Enable this service to fully utilize the power of ClipZ. We do not use it for any purpose outside of its functions, and your data is not sent over the network.
If you installed the app from untrusted sources (outside Google Play Store or your phone manufacturer's app store), it may have been modified, increasing the risk of data theft.
For more details about this accessibility service, contact us at support@clipzboard.com"

Floating icon and drop-down menu for text input

Here, power and simplicity come together. Securely save your texts and notes in dedicated sections, browse them effortlessly over any app or screen location, and protect them with a fingerprint or password. The smart floating bubble is always with you wherever you go, giving you instant access to everything you need.
Welcome to the world of ClipZ 🚀

"Embark on a creative journey with the power of AI in ClipZ! You'll transition to a completely different experience. Translate, edit, summarize, correct, or rephrase texts in a professional style. In addition, you'll be able to create creative content with a single click. It's like having a personal assistant who always works with you."
The power of AI is in your hands 🤖

"The floating bubble isn't just an icon; it's a super tool that stays with you all the time. Extract text from any app or web page, automatically fill text fields with your last copied text or saved notes, and quickly access all app functions from any application. You can also customize the bubble's location, size, or transparency to always be in the most suitable way for you."

"You'll never lose any important text again! ClipZ automatically saves every text you copy from any app, with the option to set the retention period from temporary to permanent. Also, with every copy operation, a floating element appears at the top of the screen, giving you quick access to share, save, or perform AI processing, saving you time and effort."
Automatic and smart saving for everything you copy 📝

"Accessing ClipZ functions is faster than you think! Whether through the notification bar, the control center (quick access panel), or by long-pressing system buttons (back, home, recent apps). And if you prefer quick access via the floating bubble, a single or long press on it opens a quick access menu to the app's functions!"

"With the smart sharing feature! Add your favorite apps to ClipZ and share directly to them from within the app, with support for display via a pop-up window or split screen, all without leaving the app you're using to maintain your workflow. For even more magic, the app allows you to pass extracted or saved text directly to the last selected text box in any other app. Just click the text pass icon from the app, and it will automatically appear in the writing box!"
Instant and smart sharing and pasting 🎯

ClipZ features advanced capabilities for extracting text from the screen, offering two modes: a regular one and an advanced one via scrolling, where all text objects are collected while scrolling through long pages, for example, conversations in apps, with messages separated by speaker and time, to appear in one place after you finish for you to deal with them (save, share, or refer to them later).

"ClipZ is not just a text-saving app; it's a complete and unique system that combines the power of artificial intelligence with ease of use to give you an unparalleled experience. Remember that all your texts are secure and stored locally and are never shared with us or any third party, and that periodic backup is your personal responsibility to avoid losing them in case the app is removed or the device is lost. Finally, most of the amazing features we've reviewed require activating the professional features to unleash the full experience."

"It seems you previously enabled the app's accessibility service, but its functions have stopped working. This might be because your phone's operating system forcefully stopped the app, or an error occurred during runtime, leading to the deactivation of the accessibility permission.
Note: On some phones, the permission might appear enabled in the system settings, but it is actually inactive, and the professional features won't work for you.
To solve the problem and re-enable professional features: 1. Go to the phone's system Accessibility settings. 2. Deactivate the app's permission (Turn off the service). 3. Return to the app. 4. Go to Accessibility settings again. 5. Activate the app's permission once more (Turn on the service). 6. Return to the app.
Repeat these steps more than once to ensure the permission is genuinely granted and appears as active within the app, so the professional features work again.
Important Notes: • Some phones never re-grant the permission if you don't return to the app between each deactivation and activation step. • Make sure to remove any restrictions or blocks on the app's power/battery usage, as these restrictions cause the system to automatically stop the app from working."
Remove battery saver restrictions to allow the app to run in the background.
